approaches.name: Integrated UHIS IT backbone with analytics and biometric ID
approaches.description: Builds modular UHIS enrollment, provider, claims and procurement systems plus a UHIA big-data analytics unit and biometric unique health identifier. Practices: Integrated UHIS IT backbone with payer, HIE and analytics modules; Big data analytics unit within UHIA for decision-making; Modular UHIS information system roll-out (enrollment, provider, claims); Big Data Analytics unit within UHIA; Big Data Analytics unit operationalization at UHIA; Modular UHIS information system roll-out with staged payments; Electronic beneficiary enrolment module in UHIA; Electronic provider management module in UHIA; Electronic claim management module in UHIA; Electronic procurement module in EASPMTM; Big Data Analytics unit inside UHIA analyzing UHIS operational data; Big data analytics unit within UHIA for insurance operations; Biometric-enabled unique health identifier for all beneficiaries; AI-based interoperability and big-data analytics unit informing UHIA purchasing and policy decisions.
